title: Modernize synthetic-runner into plugin-driven micro-adapters and standardize artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Our current synthetic / load test ecosystem is a mix of brittle python runners, multiple hard-coded adapters (grpc, http, websocket), and two incompatible artifact formats (pickle blobs + CSV goldens). This causes flaky regression runs, duplicate instrumentation, and expensive dev time when onboarding new scenario shapes.

Goal: Replace the monolithic runner with a lightweight plugin-driven micro-adapter model so new protocols and sampling strategies can be added without touching core orchestration. Standardize outputs to newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) with Prometheus-friendly metric labels and deterministic seed metadata for reproducible perf regressions. Achieve parity with existing test coverage and enable CI gating for runtime changes.
acceptance_criteria: Replace legacy python runner with plugin loader that can run existing grpc/http scenarios without code changes
All artifacts written as ndjson with header metadata (git sha, seed, scenario, timestamp)
Deterministic seeding is supported; rerunning same inputs + seed yields identical token sequence lengths for synthetic tests
CI: perf-regression pipeline can execute a smoke suite in <12m and post artifacts to S3 and PerfDash automatically
Metrics exported to Prometheus via the same instrumentation layer used by production loadgen (no sidecar required)
Documented migration guide and at least two example adapters (k6 and grpc-java) in repo
technical_notes: Plugin model: core orchestrator exposes a tiny runner API (init, generate(batch), flush, shutdown). Adapters implement this API and live under /adapters/ in mono-repo.
Sampling: introduce an 'adaptive-sampler' that can switch between uniform, stratified, and replay modes. Initial phase ships uniform + replay with simple throttling.
Artifact format: ndjson lines with top-level keys: meta/generation/metrics. Meta must include seed, commit, scenario id, and adapter name.
Backwards compatibility: include a compatibility shim to translate old pickle artifacts to ndjson for comparisons during migration window.
Dependency upgrades: evaluate replacing locust-based python harness with k6 (javascript) adapter for browser-like workloads; bump prometheus client libs to v0.14.0 in go-runner.
Observability: align trace IDs with PerfDash trace model; tag each request with 'synthetic=true' and scenario labels for filtering.
CI integration: new job perf-harness/ci-run triggers on runtime PRs; gate threshold is 5% median latency regression or 10% p95 regression relative to goldenset.
Rollout: canary runs on staging cluster first, then mandatory run on dedicated perf cluster before merging runtime changes. Failure mode reverts to legacy runner for 24h automated fallback.
Risk: adapter proliferation could reintroduce duplication; enforce review checklist and adapter template to keep surface area minimal.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): implement orchestrator and two adapters (grpc, http). Add ndjson writer and deterministic seed support.
Phase 2 (1 week): CI job and perf smoke suite migration. Run parallel against legacy runner for 1 week to validate parity.
Phase 3 (1 week): add k6 adapter and Prometheus label migration. Educate on new artifact format with a short workshop.
Phase 4 (1 week): deprecate legacy runner; remove from CI after 2 successful weeks of parity and no flakiness incidents.
Post-release: maintain an adapters backlog and convert existing scenario library to ndjson goldens over next quarter.
updates: 2025-02-28: Ticket created after triage call. Decision to standardize on ndjson and minimal runner API agreed by infra and eval teams.
2025-03-03: Spike completed — prototype adapter and ndjson writer produced. Observed 8% variance vs legacy runner on p95 for grpc scenario. Investigating deterministic seeding edge-cases.
2025-03-06: Review feedback from Design/PM: add clearer metadata fields (team, environment, scenario_tags). Raised estimate from 3 -> 5 points due to CI integration complexity.
2025-03-09: Security reviewed superficial concerns; no secrets in artifacts. Confirmed Prometheus metrics reuse is acceptable. Marked security_review_required=false.
2025-03-10: Ready to start Phase 1 implementation. Rafael to create branch eng-77801/runner-rewrite and coordinate with ENG-51234 for seeding util library.
Notes: Track flaky runs carefully — add automatic rerun with jitter and capture deterministic seed on failure for debug.
